description_en: Modifies the description and retention period of a full backup file
description_zh: 该接口用于变更用户备份的备注信息和保留时长
kebab_example: aliyun rds update-user-backup-file --backup-id b-g14d0m772f7b0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --comment CommentTest --retention 30 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateUserBackupFile

parameters.help_en: The backup ID. You can call the ListUserBackupFiles operation to query the backup ID
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The new description of the full backup file
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The new retention period of the full backup file. Unit: days. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的用户备份保留时长。单位：天。取值为大于0的Integer类型整数
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口获取
parameters.name: resource_group_id
